title: Predictive Warm Pool and Rate-Envelope Gatekeeper for Dedicated Fleet Stability
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Adds predictive warm pool sizing and a rate-envelope gatekeeper to improve SLA stability for Dedicated fleets. Configurable by tenant and rollout via feature flag. Includes new telemetry and dashboards for utilization and burst accounting.
description: Context and motivation: Dedicated fleets occasionally experience micro-surge cascades where concurrent short bursts from multiple tenants exhaust warm capacity and trigger heavy provisioning, causing SLA blips and increased cost. This PR introduces two coordinated mechanisms: 1) a predictive warm pool resizer that uses short-term request rate forecasts and cold-start cost heuristics to proactively maintain a small warm buffer, and 2) a rate-envelope gatekeeper that shapes per-tenant ingress to avoid synchronized microbursts exceeding headroom thresholds. Summary of changes: predictive warm pool controller, rate-envelope admission controller, tenant-level rate envelope config, smoothing-based utilization estimator, new telemetry endpoints and dashboards, e2e and unit tests, migration script for existing tenant configs. Related work: builds on ENG-4921 (utilization smoothing), complements recent autoscaler throttles. Links: Linear ENG-4921 ENG-5038. Checklist: [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-4921 [x] unit tests added [x] e2e in benchmark-lab passing [x] console dashboard wires [x] feature flag gated rollout [x] docs updated in redwood-docs. Commits summary: Commit 1: controller scaffolding and tests for predictive resizer; Commit 2: rate-envelope admission controller and per-tenant policy API; Commit 3: utilization estimator and telemetry exporter; Commit 4: integration wiring with autoscaler and backlog reconciler; Commit 5: migration script and documentation updates; Commit 6: final tweaks after reviewer feedback. Files changed (high level): services/fleet-controller/pkg/pool/resizer.go - new predictive resizer; services/fleet-controller/pkg/gatekeeper/envelope.go - admission logic and policy; services/fleet-controller/api/v1alpha/tenant_rate_envelope.proto - new API surface; console/dashboards/dedicated/warm_pool_overview.json - dashboard; observability/exporters/warm_pool_metrics/exporter.go - telemetry; benchmark-lab/scenarios/predictive_pool_smoke.yaml - e2e scenario; docs/dedicated/warm-pool.md - docs; scripts/migrations/add-rate-envelope-configs.sql - migration. Testing and CI: Initial CI run flagged flakiness in benchmark-lab scenario under constrained CPU; addressed by tightening mock timers and adding retry in harness. Final CI: all checks green, integration benchmark stable within 5% of baseline. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to 5% of tenants with Dedicated fleets for 48h, monitor warm_pool_waste_ratio and tenant_sla_miss_rate dashboards; expand to 25% then 100% if stable. Fallback: feature flag off triggers graceful drain of warm pool and deletion of per-tenant envelopes. Backwards compatibility: controller stores envelope config in v1alpha with migration script; older controllers ignore new fields. Observability: new metrics warm_pool_target_size, warm_pool_actual_size, envelope_denials_total, envelope_throttled_duration_seconds, utilization_smoothed_p50/p90, warm_pool_cost_savings_estimate; dashboards and alerts added. Performance: predictive resizer yields median 18% reduction in provisioning events in our benchmark-lab replay and a 6% reduction in per-token cost for warm-sensitive workloads. Security and safety: rate-envelope enforces tenant-level max burst tokens; admission decisions are recorded in audit logs. Migration and DB: migration script creates tenant_rate_envelope table and populates defaults for existing tenants. Deploy notes: requires console and observability components to be applied alongside fleet-controller; migration to be run once per region. Known limitations: current predictor uses short 60s window and can underperform for long-tail periodic bursts; plan to iterate with longer-horizon models (ENG-5038).
